lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of low-contrast, roughly circular high-luminance pixel clusters situated posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the circular clusters to form a coarse grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A subtle horizontal linear feature characterized by a vertical luminance gradient, visible along the upper dorsal-lateral boundary of the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A discrete, elongated high-luminance object is located ventrally, immediately anterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
